notes.title: PAD Hotfix 7 - GLITCH FIXED IN DESCRIPTION
notes.notes:
[b]If you have an AMD GPU, updating to the latest AMD update will cause serious problems![/b]
(25.8.1 = UNPLAYABLE)
 
[b]The fix is to simply go back one update on your AMD GPU![/b]

If you still have glitch errors lmk!

[list]
[*]also fixed treasure chests dropping nothing
[/list]

notes.title: PAD Hotfix 5
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Ghost Crabs Die at the end of the Spectral Gem Fight
[*]You can skip the Dialog from the Pacifist Ending to save time

[*][b]Hints for the Pacifist Ending:[/b]

[*]The Stars are found in the space station
[*]Don't Overthink the Crab Claw
[*]The # for the Diamonds is found in the lobby before you start a multiplayer game
[*]Don't Overthink the Gem
[*]The UFO symbol is found at the start of the yellow gem fight. The # of that symbol is the # you input

[*][b]If you get stuck, JOIN the discord for help![/b]

[/list]
